description: Synthetic sesslint.verify parity: module exports, canonical fixture bundles, strict parse gates, dataclass serialization, and human rendering from pinned Python.
known_parity_gaps: GAP-verify-invalid-utf8: Python _parse_session_events surfaces CPython UnicodeDecodeError text; Rust reports invalid UTF-8 (not byte-compared here).

GAP-verify-end-to-end: verify() on committed fixture bundles calls sesslint.report.parse_manifest in Python; Rust returns sesslint.report.parse_manifest is not available (fixture directories are not vector-compared here).
GAP-verify-cli: CLI argv, capsys, exit codes, and main() integration are not byte-compared here.
GAP-verify-api-entry: tests/test_api_surface.py::test_verify_contract calls sesslint.api.verify rather than sesslint.verify.verify.
GAP-verify-fs-hostile: symlink, chmod, missing-path, and directory-as-file tests depend on host filesystem semantics.
GAP-verify-repair-bootstrap: no-plan and executor-emitted manifest paths require sesslint.repair and live replanning.
GAP-verify-runner-integration: checks.runner parity and profile gating in tests/checks/test_runner.py are outside isolated verify symbols.
GAP-verify-adversarial-matrix: parametrized corrupt_file/empty_target/bad_root cells are not one-vector-per-pytest.
GAP-verify-wave1: tests/test_wave1_correctness.py does not exercise sesslint.verify.
GAP-verify-dataclass-to-dict: test_verdict_and_check_dataclasses also calls Check.to_dict and Verdict.to_dict. The dataclass vector compares Verdict.to_json only, so that row is not the whole test.
